title: The Skill of Long-Term Investing
intro: Six months of intensive personal coaching in which you master the skill of long-term investing, step by step, with an experienced investor and teacher at your side.
highlights: Weekly assignments and independent study materials
Thesis defense and exam every two weeks
why_text:
You want to truly understand the financial markets and master the skill of long-term investing. But the information in books, videos, personal opinions and social media is scattered, often contradictory and confusing. It does not lead to a clear strategy or a strong set of skills.

What is missing is not more information. It's a complete, professional program with an experienced coach working one-on-one with you: a seasoned investor and teacher who helps you develop a coherent skill, step by step, and gives you the clear, honest feedback you need to invest with confidence.
learn_text:
In six months, you learn the skill of long-term investing. You develop and defend your own investment theses, and construct a complete portfolio the way professionals do.

You learn how financial markets actually work and what makes prices move. You build a solid foundation in market knowledge, investing philosophy and psychology.

You leave with real, applied experience. In week one you open your own paper portfolio with $100,000 in starting capital: six months of investing, analyzing and portfolio building in your own paper account.
for_points: You have explored the markets, or traded or invested a bit, and now want to turn that experience into a lasting skill
You want to aim high, and you accept that there are no guarantees
You can commit 4 to 6 hours a week, for six months
You are willing to study, practice and receive honest feedback
notfor_title: This is not for you if
notfor_points: You are looking for signals, picks, or someone to tell you what to buy
You expect quick or guaranteed returns
You want a 30-day shortcut. This is a six-month program, and that time is exactly what builds the skill

requirements.title: Intro call
requirements.text: Every student is accepted after a personal intro call, to make sure the program is the right fit.

requirements.title: Basic market knowledge
requirements.text: You know what a stock is and what the financial markets are.

requirements.title: Tools
requirements.text: A computer with Excel or Google Sheets.

requirements.title: Language
requirements.text: You are comfortable following lessons in English.

year_intro: The program runs for six months in four phases. Each phase builds on the previous one, taking you from a solid foundation to full independence.

quarters.label: Month 1
quarters.title: Foundation
quarters.text: You define who you are as an investor: your goals, your time horizon and your objectives, and you learn to understand a business completely. By the end, you have your first Investment Policy Statement (IPS) and your paper portfolio is up and running.

quarters.label: Months 2–3
quarters.title: Understanding businesses and value
quarters.text: You learn how a business shows up in the numbers, compare price with value, judge quality with a full annual report analysis and map an industry and its moats. Your first positions open, each with a one-page thesis.

quarters.label: Months 4–5
quarters.title: Valuation and the thesis
quarters.text: You build your own DCF and reverse DCF model, learn to read the consensus, judge management and capital allocation, and write a five-page investment memo. Every position now has a valuation model and a margin of safety.

quarters.label: Month 6
quarters.title: Behavior and independence
quarters.text: You study risk, market psychology and your own behavior, audit your decision journal and defend your 20-year plan. By the end, you have finished your IPS and investment plan, and you manage your paper portfolio entirely on your own.

how.title: Weekly 1:1 session (60 min)
how.text: We discuss the core chapter of the week, review last week's assignment, share the self-study material, track your paper portfolio, analyze companies on your watchlist and prepare the next assignment. Fully tailored to your progress.

how.title: Weekly independent study
how.text: A book chapter, an academic paper or memo, or a video. Additional material is available if you want to go deeper.

how.title: Weekly practical assignment
how.text: To apply what you learned right away.

how.title: Exam every two weeks
how.text: A questionnaire, analysis or case study that closes each topic. If you don't pass, you get detailed 1:1 feedback and a second attempt.

how.title: Thesis defense every two weeks
how.text: You defend the assignment of each topic, such as part of your IPS, a valuation model or a portfolio update. You pass when your reasoning holds up under scrutiny. If not, you get feedback and a second attempt.

how.title: Review at months 3 and 6 (90 min)
how.text: At months 3 and 6 we review your progress, research process and decision journal.

how.title: Built-in flexibility
how.text: A one-week break and two personal flex weeks for holidays, illness, catching up or a retake.

deliverables_intro: You leave with a complete, personal investing system, usable for the rest of your life.

deliverables.title: Your Investment Policy Statement (IPS)
deliverables.text: Your personal rulebook: goals, required return, allocation, position limits, holding policy and crisis protocol, rewritten as your skills grow.

deliverables.title: Your Investment Plan
deliverables.text: How the rules get applied: your long-term plan, a crash playbook, and written sell rules for every holding.

deliverables.title: Your Spreadsheet Toolkit
deliverables.text: A personal dashboard, a discounted cash flow (DCF) model, sensitivity analysis, and simulators for position sizing, rebalancing and retirement.

deliverables.title: Your Investment Memos
deliverables.text: The written arguments behind your key decisions, from one-page theses to a five-page memo and a letter to your future self.

deliverables.title: Six Months of Real Practice
deliverables.text: Your paper portfolio and decision journal: six months of documented decisions, two reviews, and lessons you can point to.

assessed_text: Great investors are built on great decisions, not short-term outcomes. That's why we measure what you control and what leads to results over the long term: your process, reasoning and discipline. Your exams, thesis defenses and paper portfolio decisions show exactly where you stand and what to work on next.
coach_text:
I started my career as a professional trader at an Amsterdam-based proprietary trading firm. After strong results in the Peak Capital Trading bootcamp, I earned a seat at Andrew Aziz's firm, Peak Capital Trading.

Today I invest independently for the long term and teach long-term investing in a Canadian trader education program. Years of working in the markets taught me what really makes the difference: not the next big idea, but discipline, a clear process and control over your own behaviour.

faq.question: Do you guarantee returns?
faq.answer: No. The evidence says most who chase outperformance fail, and I will show you that evidence in the first month. What I commit to is the training: high-quality education, honest feedback, and 1:1 guidance in skill development. In the end, however, the market owes nobody a thing.

faq.question: Will I actually beat the market after this?
faq.answer: Maybe not, but by the end of the program you will know whether to try, and how. The skills transfer either way: understanding businesses, valuing them, managing risk and managing your own psychology pay off in your career, your business, and every financial decision you make after this program.

faq.question: Is this investment advice?
faq.answer: No. This is an education and coaching program. I teach you how to build and follow your own investing process. I never give buy, sell or hold recommendations, and all exercises take place in a paper portfolio.

faq.question: What if I fall behind?
faq.answer: Two flex weeks exist precisely for that. The program extends; it does not skip. Sequence matters more than speed.

faq.question: Why six months?
faq.answer: Because understanding businesses and markets, building a valuation and surviving a defense are skills, and skills take practice. Six focused months with weekly 1:1 sessions give you the full process, and enough real decisions for the psychological layer to show itself.

faq.question: What if I start and realize it's not for me?
faq.answer: You can withdraw within the first 10 days and receive 100% of your payment back.

faq.question: Is the coaching online?
faq.answer: Yes. All sessions take place online, so you can join from anywhere.

faq.question: How much does it cost?
faq.answer: We discuss the investment and the payment options in your intro call.
